decisions.reason: The quote directly states that NCLs are 'associated with devastating visual prognosis', which establishes the phenotype of visual decline/prognosis as a characteristic of the disease. The quoted sentence is present in the abstract and directly supports the relationship.

The quote establishes that NCLs are 'categorized into different types depending upon the underlying cause i.e., soluble lysosomal enzyme deficiencies or non-enzymatic deficiencies'. The preceding sentence (line 2-3) states 'The pathophysiological mechanisms causing NCLs occur due to enzymatic or transmembrane defects in various sub-cellular organelles including lysosomes', which clearly establishes that soluble lysosomal enzyme deficiencies are among the mechanisms causing NCL. These deficiencies are explicitly identified as underlying causes and pathophysiological mechanisms of the disease.
